mechanism: Amphotericin B causes nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that may impair donepezil metabolism and increase CNS adverse effects; donepezil's cholinergic activity may worsen amphotericin B-induced cardiac dysrhythmias from electrolyte depletion.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes (especially potassium and magnesium), and cardiac rhythm closely; consider dose adjustment or alternative antifungal if renal function deteriorates significantly.
